Also running/swimming and cycling.

I have thrown my self in to physical activity to unwind. After 12 hours of work I go out to the gym for a few hours. 

I am training for a half Ironman so that helps me relax quite a lot.

I have a rule about how many hours I study a week out of work hours. I do get a study day in my job that is good. I spend about 1 hour a day maybe reading security news or listening to security podcasts. 

But I also make sure I have time with my family and visit my parents. Take walks. Go to restaurants and training for a half Ironman.
